model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата се състои от две графики, разположени една до друга, които илюстрират промените в съотношението на рядкост в зависимост от слоя, използвайки различни прагови стойности. Двете графики споделят идентична ос X, която е обозначена като "Layer". Скалата по оста X е линейна, обхваща диапазон от 0 до малко над 20 (приблизително 24), без посочени мерни единици, като числовите означения са разположени през равномерни интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y и на двете графики е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio" и използва линейна скала. При лявата графика диапазонът на оста Y е от 0.0 до 1.0 с равномерни числови отметки през интервал от 0.2. При дясната графика диапазонът на оста Y е от 0.0 до 0.8, също с равномерни отметки през интервал от 0.2.

В лявата графика са представени три линии без маркери, илюстриращи данните при праг 1e-2. Синята линия с прекъснати къси черти започва от стойност около 0.2 при X=0, спада рязко до приблизително 0.05 при X=2 и остава почти хоризонтална, малко над нулата, до края на оста X. Оранжевата пунктирана (изградена от точки) линия стартира от максималната стойност 1.0 при X=0, запазва това ниво до X=1, след което постепенно намалява, достигайки дъно от около 0.2 при X=12. След тази точка оранжевата линия показва серия от колебания с видими върхове около X=18, X=21 и X=23 (доближаващи стойност 0.4) и спадове около X=16, X=19 и X=22. Зелената линия, съставена от черти и точки, започва близо до 1.0 при X=0, спада относително стръмно до около 0.7 при X=3, а след това по-плавно продължава да се понижава до около 0.15 при X=13. От X=13 до края на графиката зелената линия остава на постоянно ниво, малко над 0.1, без съществени колебания.

В дясната графика са изобразени три линии без маркери, отразяващи данните при праг 1e-3. Синята линия с прекъснати къси черти стартира съвсем малко над 0.0 (около 0.02) при X=0, пада почти до 0.0 при X=1 и остава напълно плоска на това ниво до самия край на диапазона. Оранжевата пунктирана линия започва от върхова стойност около 0.8 при X=0, отбелязва първоначален рязък спад до приблизително 0.3 при X=2, след което продължава плавно да се понижава. Тя достига стойности, много близки до 0.0, около X=12, където се изравнява и остава непроменена до края на оста X. Зелената линия, съставена от черти и точки, също започва близо до 0.8 при X=0, но бележи много по-рязък първоначален спад, достигайки стойност около 0.3 още при X=1. След това продължава да намалява, изравнявайки се с нулата около X=8, като остава хоризонтална на стойност 0.0 до края на оста X.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The left line chart represents the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale from 0 to approximately 24, with tick marks evenly spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick intervals of 0.2. The chart contains three lines without distinct marker shapes. The blue dashed line, denoting the sparsity ratio before the gate, starts at x=0 with a y-value of approximately 0.2, drops sharply to near 0.0 by x=2, and remains flat at this near-zero level until the end of the line. The orange dotted line, representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, begins at x=0 with a y-value of 1.0, decreases to around y=0.2 by x=13, and then exhibits fluctuations, showing peaks near x=19 at approximately y=0.3 and near x=21 at approximately y=0.4. The green dash-dot line, indicating the sparsity ratio after the average gate, starts at x=0 with a y-value of 1.0, decreases steadily to approximately y=0.1 by x=12, and plateaus near this value through the end of the plotted data.

The right line chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3 across layers. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 24, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" with a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8, utilizing tick intervals of 0.2. Three lines without markers are shown. The blue dashed line for the sparsity ratio before the gate begins at x=0 just above 0.0, drops almost immediately to 0.0, and remains stable at this baseline for the rest of the chart. The orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after the gate begins at x=0 near y=0.8, decreases sharply to near y=0.05 by x=9, remains mostly flat, and shows a very slight upward movement near the end of the x-axis. The green dash-dot line for the sparsity ratio after the average gate starts at x=0 near y=0.8, decreases to near 0.0 by x=10, and maintains a stable near-zero value until the end of the data.
model_annotations.English:
The left plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate," starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, drops sharply to near 0.0 by layer 2, and remains relatively steady near 0.0 until ending at layer 23. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate," begins near 1.0 at layer 0, declines to roughly 0.4 by layer 10, and drops to about 0.2 by layer 15; it then fluctuates, showing a peak near 0.3 at layer 19, a valley near 0.2 at layer 20, and a peak near 0.4 at layer 21, before ending at approximately 0.4 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate," starts near 1.0 at layer 0, declines steadily to around 0.2 by layer 10 and roughly 0.1 by layer 13, remaining relatively flat around 0.1 before ending near 0.0 at layer 23.

The right plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate," begins slightly above 0.0 at layer 0 and remains flat at approximately 0.0 across the entire x-axis to layer 23. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate," starts near 0.8 at layer 0, declines steeply to roughly 0.2 by layer 4 and to around 0.05 by layer 10, remains near 0.05, exhibits a small peak to approximately 0.1 at layer 21, and ends near 0.05 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate," starts near 0.8 at layer 0, declines steeply to roughly 0.1 by layer 5, reaches near 0.0 by layer 10, and remains flat at approximately 0.0 through layer 23.
model_annotations.German:
Zwei nebeneinanderliegende Liniendiagramme stellen die Sparsitätsrate (Sparsity Ratio) der SDPA-Ausgabe über verschiedene Netzwerkschichten hinweg dar. Für beide Diagramme ist die x-Achse linear skaliert, trägt die Beschriftung "Layer" und repräsentiert einen numerischen Wertebereich von 0 bis etwa 24. Entlang der x-Achse befinden sich numerische Tick-Markierungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse trägt in beiden Fällen die Beschriftung "Sparsity Ratio" und verwendet eine lineare Skala.

Das linke Diagramm mit dem Titel "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2" zeigt eine y-Achse mit einem Wertebereich von 0.0 bis 1.0 und Tick-Intervallen von 0.2. Es enthält drei Linien ohne zusätzliche Punktmarkierungen. Die dunkelblau gestrichelte Linie ("sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03") beginnt bei x=0 mit einem y-Wert von etwa 0.2, fällt bis x=2 schnell ab und verläuft für den Rest der x-Achse extrem flach nahe y=0.0, wo sie bei x=23 endet. Die orange gepunktete Linie ("sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44") startet bei x=0 nahe y=1.0, sinkt kontinuierlich bis x=13 auf etwa y=0.2 ab und zeigt im weiteren Verlauf deutliche Schwankungen mit mehreren Spitzen und Senken zwischen y=0.15 und y=0.4, bevor sie bei x=23 bei etwa y=0.4 endet. Die grün strichpunktierte Linie ("sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33") beginnt ebenfalls nahe y=1.0 bei x=0, fällt entlang der x-Achse ab, erreicht bei x=10 etwa y=0.2 und sinkt mit schwächeren Modulationen weiter ab, um am Ende der x-Achse bei x=23 bei ungefähr y=0.05 zu enden.

Das rechte Diagramm trägt den Titel "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-3". Hier reicht die y-Achse von 0.0 bis 0.8 mit Tick-Intervallen von 0.2. Auch dieses Diagramm zeigt drei Linien. Die dunkelblau gestrichelte Linie ("sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003") startet bei x=0 bei etwa y=0.05, fällt sofort auf null ab und verläuft absolut flach bei y=0.0 bis zu ihrem Ende bei x=23. Die orange gepunktete Linie ("sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126") beginnt bei x=0 nahe y=0.8, weist einen steilen initialen Abfall auf etwa y=0.2 bei x=4 auf und verläuft ab x=10 nah an der Nulllinie, weist jedoch kleine Erhebungen auf, wie etwa eine leichte Spitze nahe y=0.05 bei x=21, bevor sie bei x=23 nahe 0.0 endet. Die grün strichpunktierte Linie ("sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080") beginnt bei x=0 ebenfalls nahe y=0.8, fällt rasch ab und nähert sich bereits ab x=5 dem Wert y=0.0 an; ab dort verläuft sie durchgehend flach nahe null bis zu ihrem Endpunkt bei x=23.
